issues.on_page: Documentation of Transfers: General Fund to Savings Fund 43,805.81 + Sinking Fund to Savings Fund 15,000.00 = 58,805.81; handwritten 'See Attached Additional Transfers'
issues.issue: Lines 16/28 (p1) print 58,806.81, but the Documentation of Transfers page adds up to 58,805.81, which is 1.00 less. The rules say transfers come from that page. The extractor used lines 16/28 and assumed the 1.00 is on the attached page. That is defensible, but the 1.00 gap is only in notes and is not recorded in report_discrepancies. Transfers in and out are equal, so the roll-forward is unaffected.
